name: restricted
description: Default capability profile. Strict deny baseline: privilege escalation, delivery, destructive-write, and self-run commands are denied; tmpfs/empty masks are layered over every credential and host-state path so they stay invisible to the sandbox. Writable roots are adapter-supplied at compose time and never pinned here.
writable_note: Adapter-supplied at compose time (opts.writableRoots, e.g. the repo .gos directory and a scratch directory); this file never declares writable roots.

masks.why: runner trust store (counters, breaker, lock, approval stamps) must be invisible to the sandbox
global git config (url.insteadOf, credential.helper, core.sshCommand levers)
signing material (gpg keyrings for commit/tag signing)
host state: seeded read-only from the runner snapshot, never writable-bound
host state: model-provider auth readable by design, scratch state ephemeral
